# Tezos Systems

> A source-backed, live Tezos dashboard and public research archive built by Primate.

Tezos Systems presents Tezos L1 and Etherlink network activity, governance, staking, bakers, protocol history, markets, recognition archives, personal browser-local tools, and reproducible public datasets. Live surfaces disclose their source and freshness; a failed refresh retains the last complete reading rather than presenting partial data as current.

## Canonical destinations

- [Dashboard](https://tezos.systems/): Live Tezos dashboard, command search, topic rooms, widgets, and My Tezos
- [Explore Tezos](https://tezos.systems/chambers/): Choose a question-led topic and browse every focused Tezos room
- [My Tezos](https://tezos.systems/my/): Make a wallet or .tez name the center of a personal Tezos dashboard
- [Protocol Anthology](https://tezos.systems/anthology/): Self-amendment lore, upgrade arc, debates, and the documented amendment record
- [Tezos L1 Governance](https://tezos.systems/chamber/): Current vote room, quorum, baker ballots, and governance context
- [Network Pulse](https://tezos.systems/pulse/): Consensus, economy, market, governance, activity, and ecosystem cards in one live chamber
- [Capital Chamber](https://tezos.systems/capital/): Cross-layer Tezos and Etherlink activity, markets, ecosystem assets, real-world assets, and art-economy intelligence
- [Ecosystem Activity](https://tezos.systems/ecosystem/): Weekly active-wallet rankings and complete on-chain history for reviewed Tezos L1 and Etherlink dapps
- [Staking Chamber](https://tezos.systems/stake/): Large stake and unstake moves, current staking share, and the complete >10K history
- [Tezos Maxis](https://tezos.systems/maxis/): Canonical Tezos crowns, L1 and L2 governance records, protocol-season races, career Passports, and permanent Champions
- [TezosCRP Recognition Hall](https://tezos.systems/tezoscrp/): Official Tezos Commons monthly community awards, identity totals, categories, and source-receipted history since October 2020
- [Network Health](https://tezos.systems/health/): Blocks, Nakamoto coefficients, consensus timing, Octez versions, missed rights, and the Teztale lens
- [Liquidity Baking](https://tezos.systems/lb/): LB votes, OFF-vote EMA, subsidy state, and liquidity lore
- [Tezos X](https://tezos.systems/tezosx/): Etherlink TVL, transaction tape, gas oracle, and L2 activity
- [Tezos X Governance](https://tezos.systems/l2chamber/): Etherlink FAST, SLOW, sequencer, and governance contract tracks
- [tz4 Adoption](https://tezos.systems/tz4/): BLS consensus keys, pending switches, adoption power, and holdouts
- [Ledger Flow](https://tezos.systems/ledger-flow/): Transfer paths around any Tezos account: sent, received, and first funding
- [Tezos Domains](https://tezos.systems/domains/): .tez lookup, live registrations, auctions, offers, and expiry pressure
- [ctez Oven Exit](https://tezos.systems/ctez/): Find and close legacy ctez ovens safely through wallet-reviewed steps
- [Whale Watch](https://tezos.systems/whales/): Large tez movement, grouped flow stories, dormant large accounts, and verified awakenings
- [Staking Guide](https://tezos.systems/staking/): Delegation, direct staking, reward timing, and APY context
- [Governance Guide](https://tezos.systems/governance/): How Tezos self-amendment works, live voting, and governance RSS
- [Bakers Directory Guide](https://tezos.systems/bakers/): Browse active bakers and learn how to choose a delegation lane
- [Chain Compare Guide](https://tezos.systems/compare/): Tezos compared with Ethereum, Solana, Cardano, and Algorand
- [Tezos vs Ethereum](https://tezos.systems/compare/tezos-vs-ethereum.html): Tezos compared with Ethereum, Solana, Cardano, and Algorand
- [Tezos vs Solana](https://tezos.systems/compare/tezos-vs-solana.html): Tezos compared with Ethereum, Solana, Cardano, and Algorand
- [Tezos vs Cardano](https://tezos.systems/compare/tezos-vs-cardano.html): Tezos compared with Ethereum, Solana, Cardano, and Algorand
- [Tezos vs Algorand](https://tezos.systems/compare/tezos-vs-algorand.html): Tezos compared with Ethereum, Solana, Cardano, and Algorand
- [Baker Directory](https://tezos.systems/leaderboard/): Discover active bakers through transparent on-chain capacity, tenure, governance, and tz4 signals
- [Cycle History](https://tezos.systems/history/): Rewind core Tezos metrics across cycles and open historical charts
- [Embed Widgets](https://tezos.systems/widgets/builder.html): Build embeddable Tezos Systems stats for another site
- [Baker Count Widget](https://tezos.systems/widgets/baker-count.html): Build embeddable Tezos Systems stats for another site
- [XTZ Price Widget](https://tezos.systems/widgets/price.html): Build embeddable Tezos Systems stats for another site
- [Block Height Widget](https://tezos.systems/widgets/block-height.html): Build embeddable Tezos Systems stats for another site
- [Staking Ratio Widget](https://tezos.systems/widgets/staking-ratio.html): Build embeddable Tezos Systems stats for another site
- [Protocol Widget](https://tezos.systems/widgets/protocol.html): Build embeddable Tezos Systems stats for another site
- [Governance Widget](https://tezos.systems/widgets/governance.html): Build embeddable Tezos Systems stats for another site
- [Baker Card Widget](https://tezos.systems/widgets/baker-card.html): Build embeddable Tezos Systems stats for another site
- [Combo Strip Widget](https://tezos.systems/widgets/combo.html): Build embeddable Tezos Systems stats for another site
- [HEN Live Feed](https://tezos.systems/hen/): Teia and OBJKT collecting surface with live NFT context
- [Governance RSS](https://tezos.systems/feed.xml): Generated governance RSS for proposals, periods, and outcomes

## Public JSON data

- [Get the compact Capital launcher projection](https://tezos.systems/data/capital-entry-summary.json): The exact subset of the reviewed Capital snapshot rendered by the closed dashboard card. Cadence: After every Capital snapshot refresh. Licence boundary: Derived facts retain their source terms; original projection structure and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the complete Capital Chamber snapshot](https://tezos.systems/data/capital-snapshot.json): Cross-layer activity, markets, assets, real-world assets, and art-economy receipts. Cadence: Scheduled generated refresh. Licence boundary: Underlying API and chain facts retain their source terms; original selection, arrangement, and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the monthly chain-comparison verification receipt](https://tezos.systems/data/chain-comparison-verification.json): Displayed static comparison numbers with two distinct source checks, observed values, source hashes, and fail-closed status. Cadence: Monthly on the first day; the last-good snapshot remains when checks disagree. Licence boundary: Underlying protocol facts and source documents retain their source terms; original verification structure and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the reviewed Ecosystem Activity app manifest](https://tezos.systems/data/ecosystem-apps.json): Disclosed app identities, layers, start times, contract-discovery rules, explicit addresses, and proof URLs. Cadence: When the reviewed tracked-app universe changes. Licence boundary: Contract and chain facts retain their source terms; original selection, arrangement, and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the compact Ecosystem Activity launcher projection](https://tezos.systems/data/ecosystem-entry-summary.json): The integrity-checked trailing history, leaders, and headline aggregates rendered before the full Ecosystem room opens. Cadence: After every Ecosystem Activity ledger refresh. Licence boundary: Derived facts retain their source terms; original projection structure and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the complete Ecosystem Activity weekly ledger](https://tezos.systems/data/ecosystem-stats.json): Last-completed-week active-wallet rankings, a separate partial current-week pulse, full weekly app and cross-layer aggregates, methodology, and frozen contract receipts. Cadence: Scheduled generated refresh; recent completed weeks are deterministically rebuilt. Licence boundary: Underlying TzKT and Blockscout facts retain their source terms; original selection, arrangement, and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the governance freshness audit](https://tezos.systems/data/governance-refresh-report.json): Current protocol, voting-period, lore coverage, and stale-data blockers. Cadence: Every normal commit and scheduled generated refresh. Licence boundary: Repository-authored audit structure and commentary are covered by MPL-2.0; underlying public facts retain their source terms.
- [Get generated Tezos governance voting history](https://tezos.systems/data/governance-votes.json): Voting-period and ballot receipts reconstructed from public chain data. Cadence: Every normal commit and scheduled generated refresh. Licence boundary: Underlying chain facts retain their source terms; original selection, arrangement, and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get mutable Tezos Maxis career records](https://tezos.systems/data/maxis-careers.json): All-history governance careers, voting-period receipts, streaks, and active-delegate ranks. Cadence: Scheduled generated refresh. Licence boundary: Underlying chain facts retain their source terms; original selection, arrangement, and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the Etherlink governance career reconstruction](https://tezos.systems/data/maxis-l2-governance.json): Completed FAST, SLOW, and Sequencer windows with participant receipts. Cadence: Scheduled generated refresh. Licence boundary: Underlying Etherlink and TzKT facts retain their source terms; original reconstruction and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the canonical mixed-clock Tezos Maxis snapshot](https://tezos.systems/data/maxis-leaders.json): Ongoing lane leaders and rankings on their honestly labeled natural clocks. Cadence: Scheduled generated refresh. Licence boundary: Underlying chain and API facts retain their source terms; original scoring presentation and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the compact Tezos Maxis launcher projection](https://tezos.systems/data/maxis/entry-summary.json): The exact subset of reviewed ongoing and current-season artifacts rendered by the closed dashboard card. Cadence: After every Maxis, Maxis career, L2 governance, or season refresh. Licence boundary: Derived facts retain their source terms; original projection structure and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the Tezos Maxis season manifest](https://tezos.systems/data/maxis/manifest.json): Active, settling, and finalized protocol-season catalogue. Cadence: Scheduled generated refresh and protocol lifecycle transitions. Licence boundary: Underlying chain facts retain their source terms; original season catalogue structure and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- Get a sharded protocol-season Passport ledger — path template: `/data/maxis/seasons/{seasonId}/passports/{shard}.json`: Address-indexed season progress and badge receipts for one hexadecimal shard. Cadence: Active and settling seasons refresh on the generated schedule; finalized seasons are immutable. Licence boundary: Underlying chain and API facts retain their source terms; original selection and arrangement are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- Get a protocol-season Maxis rules receipt — path template: `/data/maxis/seasons/{seasonId}/rules.json`: Versioned evaluator, lane catalogue, boundaries, and immutable scoring terms. Cadence: Written when a season opens and frozen when finalized. Licence boundary: Repository-authored rules and schema are covered by MPL-2.0; underlying public facts retain their source terms.
- Get a protocol-season Maxis summary — path template: `/data/maxis/seasons/{seasonId}/summary.json`: Frozen or live category standings, honors, coverage, and integrity receipts. Cadence: Active and settling seasons refresh on the generated schedule; finalized seasons are immutable. Licence boundary: Underlying chain and API facts retain their source terms; original scoring presentation and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get shared Tezos milestone receipts](https://tezos.systems/data/milestone-catalog.json): Network thresholds, exact crossings, and bounded recent celebration windows. Cadence: After 14 days or 100 commits, with forced scheduled refresh support. Licence boundary: Underlying chain and TzKT facts retain their source terms; original selection, arrangement, and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the reviewed My Tezos contract registry](https://tezos.systems/data/my-tezos-contracts.json): Address classification rules used to label personal activity without inferring ownership. Cadence: When reviewed contract classifications change. Licence boundary: Repository-authored classifications and schema are covered by MPL-2.0; third-party contract facts retain their source terms.
- [Get dated Nakamoto-coefficient source reports](https://tezos.systems/data/nakamoto-sources.json): Reproducible and manually curated concentration reports with provenance. Cadence: Scheduled generated refresh with last-known-good retention. Licence boundary: Original selection and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned; third-party reports and measurements retain their source terms.
- [Get the curated Tezos protocol history](https://tezos.systems/data/protocol-data.json): Protocol chronology, upgrade changes, debates, and source links. Cadence: When an accepted protocol or curated history changes. Licence boundary: Original selection, arrangement, and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned; underlying facts and linked sources retain their source terms.
- [Get sourced protocol debate records](https://tezos.systems/data/protocol-debates.json): Curated proposal debate, rejection, and contention narratives. Cadence: When protocol debate research is curated. Licence boundary: Original selection, arrangement, and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned; quotations and linked sources retain their source terms.
- [Get the complete sourced TezosCRP archive](https://tezos.systems/data/tezoscrp-awards.json): Published recipients, categories, periods, identity evidence, and official source receipts. Cadence: Twice-monthly source check; changes only for a new official award period. Licence boundary: Official names, categories, icons, and announcements retain their source terms; original selection, arrangement, and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the compact TezosCRP recognition summary](https://tezos.systems/data/tezoscrp-summary.json): Latest official winners and totals reconciled to the complete recognition archive. Cadence: Twice-monthly source check; changes only for a new official award period. Licence boundary: Official names, categories, and announcements retain their source terms; original selection and arrangement are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get the complete trailing-24-hour Whale Watch archive](https://tezos.systems/data/whale-watch.json): Large-transfer receipts, grouped flows, dormant accounts, and awakenings. Cadence: Scheduled generated refresh. Licence boundary: Underlying TzKT facts retain their source terms; original selection, arrangement, and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned.
- [Get served build metadata](https://tezos.systems/version.json): Current committed build stamp used by the site footer. Cadence: Every normal commit. Licence boundary: Repository-authored metadata is covered by MPL-2.0.

## Sources, attribution, and licence boundary

- Primary data sources include TzKT, Octez RPC, Teztale, CoinGecko, Tezos Domains, OBJKT, Etherlink sources, Supabase history, and source links carried by individual artifacts.
- Tezos Systems is built by Primate, the baker behind Baking Benjamins and a co-founding member of Tez Capital. Tez Capital provides RPC infrastructure used by the project.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Primate411/tezos.systems) is distributed under [MPL-2.0](https://tezos.systems/LICENSE).
- [NOTICE](https://tezos.systems/NOTICE) defines the data boundary: CC BY 4.0 applies only to original selection, arrangement, and commentary to the extent Primate owns those rights; underlying facts and third-party data retain their source terms.
- [OpenAPI catalogue](https://tezos.systems/.well-known/openapi.json) is the machine-readable inventory for the JSON artifacts above.
